purpose: Goal-first backward verification: final user outcome -> real writing products -> reviews -> stage evidence -> original requirements. A green unit test alone never promotes real business quality.
generation_baseline: Financial Writing main @ 2026-11-14 before proposed goal-driven repairs

requirements.necessary_unproven_outcome: A fresh connected ChatGPT Financial session has not been witnessed executing a full user article.
New user corrections have not been classified against a real article and checked for semantic fidelity.
Real cross-topic retrieval with current revalidation has not produced a reader-approved writing improvement.
Current first-party source, complete company-universe and falsification evidence have not been verified end to end.
PrivateResearchBrief module presence does not itself prove every user-needed research job was substantively completed.
Actual competing financial theses with current primary evidence were not independently adjudicated in a live article.

requirements.goal: FINANCE_DEEP is the complete finance product, not the complete research dump
requirements.necessary_unproven_outcome: A current Deep article covering its user-required company comparison and economic causal chain has not passed user review.

requirements.goal: FINANCE_BROAD is selective acquisition, not shortened Deep
requirements.necessary_unproven_outcome: Deep and Broad differ in planning and exact prose clone defenses but actual independent reader journeys remain untested.
Actual final paragraphs have not been verified to deliver each blueprint promise and company causal transmission.
A cold reader has not verified title-to-opening-to-section-to-ending promise retention and payoff.
Source-by-source distinctive passage and structure overlap have not been independently audited for the new output.
Real new-article prose has not passed negative-example-informed human/editorial voice assessment.
Same-chat gate checks and synthetic independent signatures are not real expert/user publication certification.
Thirteen passes were defined, not shown executing on genuine source facts with persisted work products in a user task.
The live task has not delivered all four distinct real article/social/audit Word products with reader acceptance.
Real article Word pages, semantic content and final user-accessible delivery have not been inspected for a real task.
Feedback-led cross-topic learning and revalidation have not been proven on a real user-authorized sequence.
Separate-agent decision has not been quantitatively justified or disconfirmed for authentic workload constraints.
A live post-evolution article successor has not been resumed and reviewed at the new semantic quality standard.

counterexample_scenarios.user_goal: Complete normal current finance topic without asking owner to enumerate each stage
counterexample_scenarios.failure_injection: Host has no real writer, only stage artifact callbacks
counterexample_scenarios.expected: Do not infer real content or readiness from stage graph

counterexample_scenarios.user_goal: All-scope user instruction must survive both Deep and Broad from research to Word
counterexample_scenarios.expected: No phantom PASS, no hardcoded whitelist deadlock; source/semantic status explicit

counterexample_scenarios.user_goal: Do not draft before full research challenge
counterexample_scenarios.failure_injection: Discovery omits aggregated package, or Research Audit fails

counterexample_scenarios.user_goal: Company research complete while public article remains selective
counterexample_scenarios.expected: Task-specific universe truncation must block, ordinary publication remains selective

counterexample_scenarios.user_goal: Distinct Deep/Broad stories, not a shortened Deep
counterexample_scenarios.failure_injection: Clone story blueprint, then deliver different-title Word with duplicated body
counterexample_scenarios.expected: Reject clone, but do not claim distinct reader values

counterexample_scenarios.user_goal: Natural original narrative must improve rather than just satisfy formatting
counterexample_scenarios.failure_injection: Real rejected sea-wind 4x3 template geometry and generic scaffolding
counterexample_scenarios.expected: Flag rejected structure without false rejection on distinct rutile topic

counterexample_scenarios.user_goal: A false financial claim cannot gain factual authority from matching hash
counterexample_scenarios.failure_injection: A contradictory trend/period/unit is attributed to a matching snapshot
counterexample_scenarios.expected: Mechanical contradictions fail, semantic fact entailment remains OPEN

counterexample_scenarios.user_goal: Any correction must invalidate downstream content and reopen the right stage
counterexample_scenarios.failure_injection: User changes a late-stage task requirement after drafting
counterexample_scenarios.expected: Reopen at earliest affected stage; stale editorial PASS invalidated

counterexample_scenarios.user_goal: Uncertified but internally reviewed Word draft may be delivered honestly
counterexample_scenarios.failure_injection: No independent editor, internal QA tied to exact DRAFT bytes
counterexample_scenarios.expected: Draft export, not independent publication certification

counterexample_scenarios.user_goal: Actual current stock/policy facts cannot be exported from stale source bytes
counterexample_scenarios.failure_injection: Seven-day-old source snapshot or changed source after research
counterexample_scenarios.expected: Block delivery and return to research

required_live_business_outcome: Use real current primary sources and actual article data, not fabricated provider callbacks.
Produce distinct Deep, Broad, platform short-copy and audit Word files with current article identity.
Independently verify title promise, company causal economics, originality, factual entailment, style and section-specific reader value.
Run user correction, alternate topic and mid-stage failure replay with durable readback.
Record the user's real evaluation without manufacturing an acceptance decision.
